selection_policy: No base architecture family is preselected. DP-00 selection will be driven first by measured QA-01 and QA-02 results under QA Evaluation Contract v1, with the remaining QAs used for trade-off, regression, hard-gate, and mitigation analysis.

decision_points.title: Primary Reasoning & Execution Boundary
decision_points.decision_question: Does primary substantive reasoning and execution authority reside in an agent-neutral VIA Control Plane or a primary general-purpose Agent Runtime?

alternatives.name: Agent-neutral Control Plane
Primary General-purpose Agent Runtime
R1 with bounded deterministic read-only local tactic

decision_points.structural_discriminator: Ownership of substantive semantic interpretation, domain planning, arbitrary tool execution, workflow state, and specialist delegation across the VIA-to-Agent boundary.
legacy_mapping: Historical A is structurally informative for R1 without score transfer.
Historical B is structurally informative for R3 without score transfer.
Historical C supplies local-execution lessons only and is not automatically R1+@.
Historical D is adaptive-routing evidence and is not an active base family.

decision_points.title: Canonical User-Turn Authority
decision_points.decision_question: When Voice/S2S, streaming ASR, Text, and interaction events coexist, which boundary owns the committed logical UserTurn?

alternatives.name: Native/S2S turn authority with VIA identity/state mapping
VIA canonical-turn authority using Voice/ASR/Text/UI evidence

decision_points.structural_discriminator: Authoritative UserTurn identity, commit/revision state, reconciliation, and interface direction when streams disagree.
legacy_mapping: Migrates legacy DP-08 modality authority and part of legacy DP-02 current-turn evidence authority.

decision_points.title: VIA Semantic Decision Responsibility Topology
decision_points.decision_question: Within R1, are grounded-goal construction and initial Agent routing separate authoritative responsibilities or one unified VIA decision aggregate?

alternatives.name: Separate GroundedRequest and AgentDecision authorities
Unified RequestDecision authority

decision_points.structural_discriminator: Authority, artifact ownership, dependency direction, and version lifecycle for grounded goal and initial routing.
legacy_mapping: Migrates legacy DP-10 and absorbs structural authority from legacy DP-11.

decision_points.title: Temporal Evidence Retention Authority
decision_points.decision_question: Who remains authoritative for historical interaction evidence after its source or current state changes?

alternatives.name: VIA-owned materialized historical evidence
Source-owned versioned/pinnable history plus VIA time/reference broker

decision_points.structural_discriminator: Persistent historical-evidence ownership, pin/version authority, retrieval dependency, and post-mutation availability boundary.
legacy_mapping: Migrates the temporal-retention part of legacy DP-02; legacy capability-placement DP-03 retains historical identity only.

decision_points.title: Agent Request Context Materialization Boundary
decision_points.decision_question: Must required context be materialized before Agent admission, or may execution retain scoped context-resolution capability?

alternatives.name: Pre-admission self-contained request package
Grounded request plus versioned/scoped context handles and lifecycle broker

decision_points.structural_discriminator: Whether context resolution ends at admission or remains a scoped, authorized lifecycle dependency.
legacy_mapping: Supersedes the old DP-04 number; legacy execution-contract work is a supporting decision.

decision_points.title: UserTask to Native Agent Session Binding
decision_points.decision_question: Do independent UserTasks share a native Agent session or receive isolated native execution state?

alternatives.name: Shared long-lived Agent session
Task-scoped native Agent session

decision_points.structural_discriminator: Native conversational/execution state ownership, isolation, correlation, persistence, and cleanup across UserTasks.
legacy_mapping: Absorbs state-isolation portions of legacy DP-09 and DP-13.

decision_points.title: Interaction Frontend to Task Supervisor Runtime Boundary
decision_points.decision_question: Does authoritative UserTask supervision share the frontend runtime lifecycle or live in an independently running durable Task Service?

alternatives.name: Co-hosted interaction and task-supervision runtime
Detached durable Task Service with typed command/event boundary

decision_points.structural_discriminator: Runtime, deployment, supervision, failure, IPC, and recovery boundaries around authoritative durable Task state.
legacy_mapping: Absorbs legacy DP-13, DP-14, and the task-supervision portion of DP-15.

decision_points.title: Voice/Text Semantic Response Authority
decision_points.decision_question: Who owns the semantic meaning of user-facing Voice summary and Text detail?

alternatives.name: Single semantic Response Author and versioned ResponsePlan
Channel-owned semantic authors plus fact/version reconciliation

decision_points.structural_discriminator: Semantic publication authority, response-state ownership, reconciliation direction, and version lifecycle.
legacy_mapping: Reuses a formerly inactive number; historical legacy DP-07 model/provider policy remains policy.

decision_points.title: On-device Inference Resource Topology
decision_points.decision_question: Do Voice-critical and background semantic workloads share an inference execution domain or is realtime capacity independently protected?

alternatives.name: Work-conserving shared inference pool
Realtime-isolated inference domain with enforceable boundaries

decision_points.structural_discriminator: Enforceable resource admission, capacity, failure, scheduling, and deployment boundaries for realtime inference.
legacy_mapping: Supersedes the old DP-08 number; legacy modality-unification authority migrates to DP-01.

decision_points.title: Device Capability Abstraction Boundary
decision_points.decision_question: Where are device-specific interaction, context, and capability semantics normalized?

alternatives.name: Device-neutral VIA Core model plus thin adapters/providers
Device-family runtime owns rich semantics and projects a smaller Core contract

decision_points.structural_discriminator: Authority for rich device semantics, Core/device interface direction, and ownership of device-family state and evolution.
legacy_mapping: New admitted DP; the legacy task-association DP-09 is absorbed into DP-05/06 and remains historical.
